transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the desk roster finalized for the command-post exercise starting Monday at 0600. We have three desks to fill: movement control, communications log, and sustainment tracking. Our available personnel are PFC Ortiz, SPC Bell, and Sgt Noor. Before I publish the final roster, I need to run through the standard pre-exercise process. Can I get the qualification and availability readback from personnel, signal, and logistics staff? That way we can confirm who's qualified for which desk and who's actually available before I lock in assignments.
